messages:
IncidentBot: Pager | incidents.high | control-plane 5xx spike detected across gateway ▸ surge in downstream auth/orglookup errors (start=1765012345) :rotating_light:
Alice Ng: seeing 502/504s at the gateway, control-plane traces show auth timeouts 200ms->1.2s then cascade 5xx. traffic spike ~03:45 UTC.
Dan Kim (oncall): on it. first pass: are we seeing a config rollout or infra change? anything in releases?
Ben Ortiz: nope from my side, no deploys in last 4h. metric spike aligns with orglookup latency from cache misses. hitting redis/memcache? checking.
Carla M: telemetry shows a config push to controlplane/cache-ttl ~03:40 that lowered TTLs for org objects. rolling window started at 03:45.
Eve Park: customers seeing API 500s? any major customers impacted yet?
Dan Kim (oncall): CUSTOMER IMPACT: partial 5xx for ~8% of requests; some mid-tier customers showing increased error rates. tagging sev=high until mitigated.
PD-Bot: PagerDuty | Incident escalated to SRE oncall Dan Kim (priority: P1)
Alice Ng: quick mitigation plan: 1) revert config-ttl change 2) enable orglookup cache bypass to fallback to sticky cache 3) raise auth circuit-breaker threshold 4) scale orglookup replicas x2.
Ben Ortiz: I can revert TTL change in CMP now. prepping patch.
Carla M: runbook step: "cache-ttl rollback" at https://redwood.runbooks/cache-ttl-rollback — follow checklists, disable rollout, verify confighash.
Dan Kim (oncall): execute revert now. Ben, confirm when pushed and we monitor.
Ben Ortiz: rolled back at 1765012520. command: `kubectl apply -f controlplane-config-v2.yaml`
Alice Ng: noticing latency drop in downstream traces already. gateway 5xx rate down from 8% -> 3% within 2m.
Carla M: enabling fallback cache routing: `POST /controlplane/v1/feature-toggle/fallback-cache ON` — toggled at 1765012645.
Dan Kim (oncall): enabling auth circuit breaker relax (threshold=150/ms -> 300/ms) to avoid mass tripping. applying patch to envoy config, patch id env-patch-776.
Alice Ng: scaling orglookup replicas: `kubectl scale deployment/orglookup --replicas=6` executed at 1765012730.
Eve Park: coordinating customer comms: drafting status page update. ETA for recovery?
Alice Ng: baseline looks like 5xx will fall to <1% in next 10-15m if trends hold.
PD-Bot: Note: contact list pinged for follow-ups after mitigation window.
Ben Ortiz: logs showing repeated backend timeouts to redis cluster: `redis ERR_TIMEOUT` — opening ticket to infra for Redis hot path.
Carla M: can we temporarily route orglookup reads to a readonly replica pool? doing canary redirect now for 10% traffic at 1765012880.
Dan Kim (oncall): good. monitor error budget and latency SLOs. set alert for any re-increase above 2% 5xx.
Alice Ng: adding a circuit-breaker fallback rule so requests hit a cached stale-value path instead of failing — patch deployed at 1765013010.
Eve Park: preparing customer note: "We observed elevated 5xx errors caused by a recent cache-ttl rollout increasing backend load on org lookup. We reverted the rollout, enabled fallbacks, and scaled replicas; error rates are decreasing. Investigating root cause and will follow up."
Ben Ortiz: created infra follow-up: RED-3421 redis connection saturation under reduced TTL churn.
Dan Kim (oncall): incident status: mitigated -> partial recovery, keeping paged rotation for 2 hours. handing to morning shift for full RCA.
Alice Ng: short-term action items: (1) keep fallback enabled for 2h, (2) monitor cache hit ratios, (3) schedule controlled TTL rollout with gradual ramp and a circuit breaker.
Carla M: long-term: add preflight canary for config rollouts affecting cache keys, add autoscale policy for orglookup on cache miss spikes.
Eve Park: communications: status page posted, customers notified via email to affected accounts.
PD-Bot: Incident resolved from pager state at 1765013920 — monitoring period started.
Dan Kim (oncall): thanks all. leaving a handoff note for next oncall: RCA steps started, logs/trace links: https://telemetry.redwood/incidents/1765012345, runbook refs included.
Alice Ng: thumbs for quick ops :thumbsup: — follow-up owners: Ben (infra), Carla (deploy), Alice (SRE RCA), Eve (comms).
Eve Park: will post postmortem draft in #postmortems by EOD tomorrow.
Carla M: closing thread for now, will re-open if error rate climbs. :white_check_mark:
